protocol.primary_metric: Per-case median clone decode wall/decode output tokens, then token-weighted aggregate.
protocol.gates: Exactly three complete ABBA groups. Complete arrays must match across arms and repetitions. Every per-case and aggregate decode spread must be <=5%. Improvement requires candidate time reduction beyond max(2%, twice spread); nonregression requires aggregate and every case within that allowance; comparison requires absolute time change beyond the allowance. Cold request wall and TTFT have independent gates. AC throughout measurement, no swap and no serious/critical OS thermal state are required. All groups and failures are retained without repeat-to-pass.
protocol.cross_group_direction_gate: A directional performance conclusion requires all three groups qualified in the same direction; inspect each group direction in the unchanged analyzer output.
protocol.scope: Finite explicitly nominated cohort. This registration adds no observations. Native serial cold requests or explicitly registered same-prompt clone lanes do not establish general serving or agent task success. Existing studies and results remain immutable.

frozen_analysis.scope: Exactly the registered groups and complete cohort; all failures retained. Top-level qualification concerns the primary decode endpoint. Cold request wall, TTFT and predeclared categories each retain their own output/noise/effect gates. Medians of registered internal repetitions precede per-case ABBA. Aggregate decode rate weights cases by output tokens. AC and thermal state sampled every five seconds. A failure is not rerun into a pass.

scope: The unchanged frozen analyzer computes each registered ABBA group. This supplement checks full job/registration identity, raw AC/thermal/swap observations, nominated runtime build IDs, cohort/cap/token counts, and exact arrays across every arm and all three groups. Every registered group and failure is retained. Clone journal events contain counters without token arrays; full clone arrays come from complete stdout. Directional primary conclusions require every original group gate plus this cross-group output/provenance gate.
